answer: Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 131 aliases means carrying 68 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. The nadir escrow is released only against a karst receipt, and the whisper audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 17 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 39 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
